Server Features

Forsaken Isle keeps the DayZ survival experience at its core, with carefully selected additions that give players more to explore, achieve and enjoy without turning the server into an overloaded modded experience.

🌲

Vanilla+ Survival

Classic DayZ survival with selected additions that expand the experience while keeping looting, survival and exploration important.

🛡️

PvE Only

No PvP and no KOS. Explore, survive, build, trade and cooperate with other survivors across Deer Isle.

🎯

Dedicated AI Island

Take on hostile AI in a dedicated island area when you want an additional combat challenge. PvP remains prohibited.

📜

Quests

Complete quests and objectives that give you additional reasons to travel, explore and progress.

💎

Collectables

Search Deer Isle for valuable collectable items and turn exploration into another rewarding part of your journey.

🌿

Drug Economy

Grow, produce and trade valuable goods as an alternative way to build your wealth and progression.

🚁

Helicopters

Take to the skies and make travelling between Deer Isle's distant locations and islands much easier.

💰

Trader Economy

A range of traders gives survivors places to buy and sell while keeping scavenging, looting and exploration worthwhile.

🗺️

Deer Isle Exploration

Explore remote islands, unusual locations, hidden areas and the many points of interest Deer Isle has to offer.

🏠

Base Building

Build a home, secure your supplies and establish somewhere to return to after your journeys across the island.

🎣

Hunting & Fishing

Hunt and fish across Deer Isle, with dedicated traders giving both activities a useful place in the server economy.

🤝

Community Focused

Built for players who enjoy cooperative survival, long-term progression and a friendly PvE community.

Still evolving: Forsaken Isle is currently being built, so features may be expanded and refined as development continues.

Server Rules

Forsaken Isle is a PvE server. PvP is not permitted anywhere on the map. Please respect other survivors, their property and the community.

🚫

No PvP / Player Killing

Do not kill, shoot at, injure or deliberately harm another player. PvP is prohibited across the entire server.

🏚️

No Base Raiding

Do not break into, damage, dismantle or exploit your way into another player's base or secured area.

🎒

No Stealing

Do not take items from another player's base, storage, tents, vehicles or other clearly owned belongings.

🚙

No Vehicle Stealing

Do not take, move, damage, strip parts from or interfere with another player's vehicle.

⚠️

No Griefing

No deliberate harassment, property destruction, base blocking, baiting infected onto players or other behaviour intended to ruin another player's experience.

🎯

AI Island

AI may be engaged on the designated AI island, but PvP between players remains prohibited there. The AI island is not a PvP zone.

💰

Traders & Black Market

Do not steal, block access, abandon vehicles or deliberately cause problems around trader and Black Market areas.

🤝

Respect Other Players

Keep the community friendly. Harassment, abuse and deliberately disruptive behaviour are not acceptable.

🛑

No Cheating or Exploits

No cheating, duping, exploiting bugs or deliberately using unintended game mechanics to gain an unfair advantage.

🚧

No-Build Zones

Certain areas of Deer Isle are designated No-Build Zones. Bases, tents, storage, structures and other persistent objects must not be placed inside clearly marked or published restricted areas.

🎫 Problems or rule breaking?
If you have a problem with another player or see someone not abiding by the rules, do not take matters into your own hands. Open a support ticket on our Discord and give staff as much information as possible. Screenshots or video are helpful if available, but are not required to report an issue.
Common sense applies. Trying to work around the wording of a rule does not make rule-breaking acceptable. Staff may act where behaviour clearly goes against the spirit of the PvE community.

SUPPORT & DISCORD

NEED HELP?

If you need assistance while playing on Forsaken Isle, our Discord is the main place to contact the server team and get support.

REPORT A PROBLEM

Found a server issue, bug or something that needs staff attention? Open a support ticket on Discord and provide as much information as possible.

REPORT A PLAYER

If another player breaks the rules, do not retaliate or take matters into your own hands. Open a Discord support ticket so staff can investigate.

HELP US INVESTIGATE: Include the player name, approximate time, location and a clear description of what happened where possible. Screenshots or video are helpful, but not required.
